data.name: Jamyatha
data.long_meaning: Jamyatha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Yatha’, meaning ‘that which exists’. In Hindu mythology, Jamyatha is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted as a golden goddess holding a lotus in one hand and a pot of gold in the other. Her blessings are believed to bring abundance and prosperity to those who seek her favor.
